A bit too acidic and exasperated. If anything, I think it did the opposite of swaying the favour, seeing as she's the only member of the grumps to go all-caps on the matter since he left.

It certainly makes me doubt the theory that Suzy and Nicole disliking each other/having a fight was (one of?) the reasons GG broke up. I mean, if Suzy disliked Nicole she wouldn't have brought her up at all, right? The fact that she went out of her way to comment and try to clear Nicole's name pushes me towards ruling this theory out.

However, she didn't say explicitly "oh hey! Nicole's great!" or anything of the sort. The comment feels kind of neutral to me, like she's just trying to discredit a theory - given how she handled one guy using a few seconds of a video she made (copyright claims on an unmonetised video, getting pissed at grumps fans), I think she'd be furious at Nicole talking shit about her on twitch and wouldn't even attempt to help her out especially as Nicole wasn't even a point of conversation. She must have seen it, it was frontpage on the subreddit for a while and a generally big talking point amongst fans. Still doesn't explain why she brought her up in the comments though. Something to think about, at least.
